stages.headline: At most how many sides can a section of a cube have?
stages.headlineEnglish: At most how many sides can a section of a cube have?
stages.problemText: At most how many sides can a section of a cube have?

stages.headline: A cube has edge 1. Find the area of the section through A, C, B₁.
stages.headlineEnglish: A cube has edge 1. Find the area of the section through A, C, B₁.
stages.problemText: A cube has edge 1. Find the area of the section through A, C, B₁.

stages.headline: Can a section of a cube be a regular hexagon?
stages.headlineEnglish: Can a section of a cube be a regular hexagon?
stages.problemText: Can a section of a cube be a regular hexagon?
stages.solutionSteps: 1. The plane through the midpoints of six edges gives a regular hexagon.
stages.solutionStepsEnglish: 1. The plane through the midpoints of six edges gives a regular hexagon.

stages.headline: A cube with edge 4 is cut through the midpoints of AA₁, BB₁ and C₁. Find the perimeter of the section.
stages.headlineEnglish: A cube with edge 4 is cut through the midpoints of AA₁, BB₁ and C₁. Find the perimeter of the section.
stages.problemText: A cube with edge 4 is cut through the midpoints of AA₁, BB₁ and C₁. Find the perimeter of the section.

stages.headline: Two parallel planes are cut by a third plane. What are the lines of intersection like?
stages.headlineEnglish: Two parallel planes are cut by a third plane. What are the lines of intersection like?
stages.problemText: Two parallel planes are cut by a third plane. What are the lines of intersection like?
stages.solutionSteps: 1. They lie in one plane and do not meet: parallel.
stages.solutionStepsEnglish: 1. They lie in one plane and do not meet: parallel.
